reportsGeoMap.title: Geography map
reportsGeoMap.sub: A map of Bangladesh coloured by orders, sales, delivered, returned or return rate. Tap a district to go down to its upazilas, and a Dhaka thana to its areas.
reportsGeoMap.offBody: It is off as shipped. Switch it on here, or in Settings, in the card "Geography map (Reports)". Until then nothing is read and no map is drawn.
reportsGeoMap.needSettings: Only a person who can change settings can switch it on.
